headlines.title: Thousands of migrants force their way into Spain’s African territory
headlines.description: Border guards in the tiny Spanish exclave of Ceuta on the Moroccan coast were overwhelmed as crowds of young men pushed through gates and swam around the border barrier, hoping to gain entry into Europe.

headlines.title: OpenAI’s ‘rogue’ agents hacked into more systems than initially reported
headlines.description: NBC News AI reporter Jared Perlo discusses an incident where OpenAI’s models went rogue and hacked into a separate AI company.

headlines.title: Trump Weighs Pulling Todd Blanche Nomination Amid Vote Delay
headlines.description: Todd Blanche’s path to becoming Attorney General hit a snag after President Donald Trump threatened to withdraw his nomination after two senators delayed a crucial vote. The sticking point is that Sen. Thom Tillis and Sen. John Cornyn insist that the DOJ commit in writing to drop a nearly $2B compensation fund that could pay Trump allies. NBC's Kelly O'Donnell reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Nancy Guthrie investigation pursuing 'every credible lead,' says Pima County Sheriff's Dept.
headlines.description: The Pima County Sheriff's Department said in a statement that investigators, "continue to pursue every possible lead," in the Nancy Guthrie case. It comes only days after Savannah Guthrie posted a video on social media, seemingly to speak to whomever is directly involved. NBC News' Tom Winter reports.

headlines.title: Mother fights to have post-pregnancy complication treated
headlines.description: In our series “The Cost of Denial,” NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports on the Oregon mother who had to fight for approval to treat the near constant pain she was in due to a common complication many women face following pregnancy.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Men detained in Guthrie investigation file notice of claim against Pima County sheriff
headlines.description: The notice comes more than five months after Carlos Palazuelos and Daniel Maddox were detained for several hours in the search for Nancy Guthrie’s kidnapper.

headlines.title: Hair found in Nancy Guthrie’s home isn’t linked to a suspect, FBI says
headlines.description: The announcement came six months after the mother of “TODAY” host Savannah Guthrie disappeared.

headlines.title: Seattle police chief resigns days after food festival shooting
headlines.description: A reason for Chief Shon Barnes’ resignation wasn’t disclosed. There have been questions this week over the release of information about the shooting Sunday, which killed two bystanders.

headlines.title: The best roll-on deodorants that keep you fresh and dry, according to derms
headlines.description: Dermatologists share what to look for in a roll-on deodorant, plus their top picks for staying fresh, dry and irritation-free.

headlines.title: Instead of popping a blister, follow this treatment plan
headlines.description: The best blister treatments are Neosporin, Band-Aids and Vaseline, according to doctors. Why you shouldn’t pop a blister and tips for preventing blisters on your feet and hands.

headlines.title: Jelly shoes are trendy again — a podiatrist explains what they actually do to your feet
headlines.description: Jelly shoes are trending again, but are they safe to wear? Podiatrists explain the risks — like blisters and lack of arch support — plus how to shop smarter.
